source_scope: Settings helper and receipt path; no native rerun or source change

observed.T04: System baseline, Dark visible+stored selection, and worker/panel replacement passed. The next expected observation, Dark surviving full extension reload, is absent; the terminal failure is full_extension_preference_or_restore_failed.
observed.T10_T40_T67: Each full-extension recheck terminates with full_extension_recheck_exception; no per-case stage detail is retained.
observed.limitations: Replacement success proves lifecycle transition only. It does not prove replacement Settings reacquisition or persistence. No cause is established.

evidence.finding: After recording replacement success, restartAndRead detaches the old panel, opens Settings and the section, then waits for a matching preference; only after that does it record survives full extension reload. Catch blocks retain stage booleans internally but discard exceptions; final safe stage is emitted only for explicitly allowlisted cases.

T04/T10 inner errors are replaced by full_extension_preference_or_restore_failed. The outer catch records that category only, except a narrow T67 safe-category path. Other failures become full_extension_recheck_exception.
The generic per-choice error has no lifecycleEvidence/contextBoundary, and guestStage is reload_observation, so captureFailure/transport classification is skipped.

ranked_unresolved_hypotheses.boundary: After replacement lifecycle pass, before the matching persistence observation
possibilities: the preference read/wait failed or observed a nonmatching visible/stored value
ranked_unresolved_hypotheses.basis: These operations occur between the last T04 pass and the next expected record. Receipt cannot distinguish them.

ranked_unresolved_hypotheses.boundary: Restoration after the first choice failure
possibilities: alternate-to-baseline selection or its observation failed
ranked_unresolved_hypotheses.basis: The wrapper category combines choice and restoration failure; no original-preference-restored record appears.

possibilities: a later CDP command timed out or failed
ranked_unresolved_hypotheses.basis: Possible but unproven; the replacement lifecycle record passed and transport class was not propagated through the inner catches.

minimal_safe_discriminating_probe.scope: Next separately authorized native run only; no retry loop
record: First-choice failure stage and restoration failure stage independently, using fixed allowlisted enums.
For restartAndRead, mark entry/completion for old-panel detach, Settings reacquisition, section open, and preference wait/read.
Retain only safe booleans/enums: replacement target changed, Settings active, section open, selected label, stored-value match, and whether recovery panel acquisition succeeded.
Preserve only existing allowlisted lifecycle/failure codes and transportFailureClass (including command_timeout); discard raw exception text, page text, URLs, and arbitrary DOM content.
minimal_safe_discriminating_probe.decision: The first failed stage distinguishes lifecycle/transport from Settings reacquisition, section navigation, preference mismatch, and restoration.

verdict: The current receipt establishes a bounded failure after successful replacement and before T04 persistence confirmation, but neither the failing substage nor the underlying cause. T10/T40/T67 generic failures are separate unresolved results; do not assume the same cause.
